payload.body: utilz-ic: hv asks me to ping you for any work. Where I stand: 0078's red run is gtools-vc's slot 50, still waiting for its GO behind 48 and 49; its test is ready and its fix follows the red. 0073's edits are all in my worktree (22 files, banked as runs/0073-wip.patch), the Swift and shell critics are reading them, and its runs queue after 0078's, its final ones after arca_swift 0.1.1. 0074 is held until 0073 lands. So I have room now. What I can take without touching anyone's files: (a) 0074's red test and its fix in a worktree of their own, landing after 0073 as its own commit, as routed; (b) a second pair of hands or eyes on 0077 or 0079, if you and cc want one; (c) 0072, if hv has said yes to the WP-09 chain. Or anything else you would rather I did.
